sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).
Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 88.0% (sc:70710@2026Q3).

Please find 3 packages below. Each of them works for us; let us know which one suits you best.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. We have reviewed your data; while the PPI-C2431 decrease allows us to adjust our offer, our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, meaning recent drops do not affect our current costs. We are pleased to accommodate your request for a 24-month contract and 60-day payment terms. However, for a 24-month duration, we must include an AS-14404 index clause to manage long-term material price volatility. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

Our proposal stands at a price of €5.41 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.49 per unit, a contract term of 24 months.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to serving you with our wide product range and reliable service.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Building on your second package, we accept the 24-month contract with 90-day payment terms and the AS-14404 index clause. 

Consequently, we can offer a revised price of €5.38 per unit. Our complete revised Angebot comprises a price of €5.38 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Furthermore, we can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. 

As your reliable distributor, we are always keen to work together closely. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
